'''''Trisetum''''' is a [[genus]] of plants in the [[Poaceae|grass family]], widespread in temperate, subarctic, and alpine habitats in much of the world.<ref>[https://www.biodiversitylibrary.org/page/234882#page/109/mode/1up Persoon, Christiaan Hendrik. 1805.  Synopsis Plantarum 1: 97-98] in Latin</ref><ref>[http://www.kew.org/data/grasses-db/www/gen00666.htm Grassbase - The World Online Grass Flora]</ref><ref>[http://www.efloras.org/florataxon.aspx?flora_id=2&taxon_id=133790 Flora of China Vol. 22 Page 325 <big>三毛草属</big> san mao cao shu ''Trisetum'' Persoon, Syn. Pl. 1: 97. 1805. ]</ref><ref>[http://luirig.altervista.org/flora/taxa/floraspecie.php?genere=Trisetum Altervista Flora Italiana genere ''Trisetum''] includes photos, drawings, and distribution maps for several species</ref><ref>[http://bie.ala.org.au/species/Trisetum Atlas of Living Australia]</ref> '''Oatgrass''' is a common name for plants in this genus.<ref>{{PLANTS|id=TRISE|taxon=Triraphis|accessdate=15 December 2015}}</ref>

==Species==
''Trisetum'' formerly included over 70 species. Over the past decade the genus has been split into smaller genera (including ''[[Graciliotrisetum]]'' and ''[[Sibirotrisetum]]'') and some species placed in other genera.<ref>Barberá, P., Soreng, R.J., Peterson, P.M., Garcia-Porta, J., Romaschenko, K., Aedo, C. and Quintanar, A. (2025), Phylogenetics and reticulation among koelerioid clades, part I: Contraction of ''Trisetum'', expansion of ''Acrospelion, Graphephorum'', and ''Tzveleviochloa''; ''Graciliotrisetum'' gen. nov. and resurrection of ''Aegialina'' (Poaceae, Pooideae, Poeae, Aveninae). ''Journal of Systematics and Evolution'', 63: 629-655. https://doi.org/10.1111/jse.13133</ref> ''[[Plants of the World Online]]'' currently accepts eight species.<ref>{{cite web |title=''Trisetum'' Pers. |url=https://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:19214-1 |website=[[Plants of the World Online]] |publisher=[[Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew]] |access-date=4 June 2025}}</ref>
*''[[Trisetum bertolonii]]'' {{small|Jonsell}} – Italy ([[Apennines]])
*''[[Trisetum caudulatum]]'' {{small|Trin.}} – Juan Fernández Islands, Chile, and southern Argentina
*''[[Trisetum clarkei]]'' {{small|(Hook.f.) R.R.Stewart}} – Afghanistan, Himalayas, Xinjiang, and western and central China
*''[[Trisetum debile]]'' {{small|Chrtek}} – China (northwestern Yunnan)
*''[[Trisetum flavescens]]'' {{small|(L.) P.Beauv.}} – Europe, Azores, northwestern Africa, and western Asia
*''[[Trisetum glomeratum]]'' {{small|(Kunth) Trin. ex Steud.}} – Hawaiian Islands
*''[[Trisetum macbridei]]'' {{small|Hitchc.}} – central Peru
*''[[Trisetum yunnanense]]'' {{small|Chrtek}} – China (Yunnan)

The [[List of Trisetum species|List of ''Trisetum'' species]] includes species accepted as of 2012.<ref>[http://herbarium.usu.edu/webmanual/info2.asp?name=Trisetum&type=treatment Grass Manual Treatment] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120605050925/http://herbarium.usu.edu/webmanual/info2.asp?name=Trisetum&type=treatment |date=2012-06-05 }}</ref>
